《The lion born in dappled sunlight eats its fill of thousands of deer.》
《The frog eggs listening to the brook are gathered by a child and crushed underfoot.》

At the change overhead, my eyes went wide.

They were transforming.
The deep-green armour—now giving off a silver radiance.

This sort of thing, this same transformation, I had seen before.
Only once. At Enoshima.

en.html:
Chachamaru"Bhai, this sight you know very well. Eggs only."
Kageaki"Chachamaru..."
Chachamaru"What, Her Highness went round distributing one egg per fellow? Nahin. The other day in Sasagawa, apun gave their armour steel a little attention."
Chachamaru"Vibration frequency, just a small change. Normally the armour steel cancels the contamination waves—wave comes, khatam. These Zero-Zero Types do the opposite. Make the wave stronger only. Same effect as having an egg planted in you."
Kageaki"...Why would you arrange such a thing?"
Chachamaru"Castle in full confusion, then drop the Forged Bomb. Easier job, no? That was the idea. Now events have taken the original plan and thrown it somewhere else entirely, but—"
Chachamaru"Waste toh nahin hua. Air-defence network, finished. Wolf and Lieutenant Colonel Cannon are getting one nice assist. See? Whatever preparation can be made, make it. Later it will come in useful only."
Kageaki"..."
Kageaki"Lieutenant General Ootori was in command of air defence, wasn't he?"
Chachamaru"...Haan."

ja.html:
茶々丸「お兄さんには馴染み深いよね。 　もちろん、〝卵〟だよ」
景明「茶々丸……」
茶々丸「御姫が一つ一つ配って回ったわけじゃない。 　こないだ篠川へ行った時、あてがあいつら の甲鉄にちょっと細工しといたんだ」
茶々丸「振動数・・・が少し変わるように。 　普通の甲鉄は汚染波を解消して無効にする けど、零零式の甲鉄は逆に強化して〝卵〟を 植えられたのと同じ効果にするってわけ」
景明「……何故そんな細工を」
茶々丸「鍛造雷弾投下の時、城内が混乱してた方が やりやすいだろうって思ったから。 　もう当初の予定とは丸っきり違った展開に なっちゃってるけど――」
茶々丸「無意味じゃないな。これで防空網は壊滅だ。 ウォルフとキャノン中佐へのいい補助アシストになる。 　何でも手は打っとくもんだねー」
景明「……」
景明「防空の指揮は、大鳥中将だったな」
茶々丸「……うん」

Then, very softly—or so it seemed—she murmured something.
